title: It’s ok.
text:
It’s ok.. I was more impressed with the little ad I saw. It doesn’t work that well but it’s ok I guess. Love the small compact size. Just wished it worked like they advertised. The cord also is so short I needed an extension cord to use with it.
It’s ok. Nothing to write home about
